messages:
Maya: 48h post-GA quick sync. Primary goals: reduce gen endpoint errors 40%, clear top-5 CS tickets, and ship one small UX doc fix. Keep it tight.
Jonah: Telemetry shows 5xx uptick for long streams (>512). Possibly KV cache eviction or batching overflow. Quick triage estimate: 1 day to root cause, 2 days to patch if runtime.
Priya: Two pilot customers hit token truncation; they want stability first. They flagged this as P1.
Rafael: Ops suggestion: short canary to drop max-batch from 64->32 in us-central for 6h during low traffic. I'll run it outside freeze.
Nora: Decision rules proposal:
- Hotfix: crash, data loss, >1% API 5xx, or >1 enterprise P1.
- Triage/urgent: single high-touch customer or regressions with workarounds.
- Enhancement: UX/docs/non-blocking.
Maya: Also require peer perf signoff for any runtime change.
Jonah: Actions:
- Jonah+Rafael: schedule canary tonight at 02:10 UTC, measure 6h window.
- Priya: collect acceptance notes from pilots and add to ticket (EOD).
- Maya: reserve up to 3 dev-days for KV cache investigation if canary indicates it.
Rafael: If canary helps, we'll need a 2h maintenance window to roll; I'll coordinate with SRE.
Priya: Small doc fix: clarify token truncation behavior + sample streaming resume snippet. 4h work.
Maya: Roadmap tweak: add "stabilize (wk1)" lane and "pilot-asks" lane. Streaming resume -> design for next minor unless pilots escalate.
Jonah: I'll add labels: hotfix, stabilize-wk1, pilot-blocker and post triage sheet link.
[deploy-bot]: Note: deploy freeze 21:30-22:30 UTC. Emergency canaries must avoid this window.
Maya: Reconvene 24h after canary completes. Keep triage notes concise for engineering pick-up. :thumbsup:
